title: Z1R Range Solid TC-5

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tuned for all-terrain exploration, the Z1r Range Solid TC-5 is bridges highway aerodynamic poise with high-flow off-road ventilation across highway asphalt and backcountry gravel. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1321g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~91 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Dual-sport with removable peak, sun visor, and moisture-wicking liner.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for dual-sport use with extended rear coverage; fits most head shapes but may feel tight on very large occipital lobes.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Z1r Z1R Range Solid TC-5: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Z1r Z1R Range Solid TC-5: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Z1r Z1R Range Solid TC-5. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in Z1r's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the Z1R Range Solid TC-5 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Z1r Range Solid TC-5 represents Z1r's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~91 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Z1r Range Solid TC-5 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
